facts.fact: Orange operates two data centres in Casablanca, one a 1MW facility (DC2, built 2015) bought from Etix Everywhere in 2021, and AWS has launched a Wavelength Zone in Orange's Casablanca data centres for customers' applications.

note: Wavelength is an edge zone with Paris as parent region, so no cloud region fact; fact date is the article's date as it gives no other.
